title: Heat and Diffusion as Defect Dissipation
summary: This paper develops a Boundary First reading in diffusion/PDE/statistical physics, centered on the claim that gradients drive state toward equilibrium under explicit exchange and boundary conditions. It translates that reading back into native terms by emphasizing that repair/dissipation analogies must reduce to the native PDE and energy estimates where applicable. The proposed evidence is deliberately concrete: heat equation energy decay, Dirichlet/Neumann contrast, and analogy firewall.

title: Light Cones as Causal Admissibility Boundaries
summary: This paper develops a Boundary First reading in special/general relativity, centered on the claim that causal structure partitions events into reachable, unreachable, and null-related regions. It translates that reading back into native terms by emphasizing that causal admissibility has a literal geometrical boundary in relativistic spacetime. The proposed evidence is deliberately concrete: Minkowski cone, timelike/null/spacelike separation, and curved-spacetime caveat.

title: Variational Action and Boundary Terms
summary: This paper develops a Boundary First reading in classical/field theory/GR, centered on the claim that a variational law is well posed only after admissible variations and required boundary data are declared. It translates that reading back into native terms by emphasizing that the same bulk action defines different well-posed problems under different boundary obligations. The proposed evidence is deliberately concrete: particle action, field-theory integration by parts, and GR/GHY mention only with specialist sourcing.

title: Bulk–Boundary Correspondence in Topological Matter
summary: This paper develops a Boundary First reading in condensed matter/topological phases, centered on the claim that boundary states encode structure constrained by bulk topological invariants. It translates that reading back into native terms by emphasizing that bulk-boundary language can be literal but requires specialist invariant and spectral machinery. The proposed evidence is deliberately concrete: simple SSH/Chern-insulator control, edge-state relation, and specialist literature review.

title: Einstein’s Post-GR Search as Representation Search under Constraint
summary: This paper develops a Boundary First reading in history/foundations of relativity, centered on the claim that alternate variables, geometries, and law spaces can be reconstructed as successive representation searches constrained by accepted physics. It translates that reading back into native terms by emphasizing that the result is a historiographic and methodological model, not a claim to complete Einstein’s program or derive new physics. The proposed evidence is deliberately concrete: historical transition graph, source-grade ceilings, and Einstein–Mayer reproduction gate, plus 1 additional evidence item.
